iconStyle: Create one individual app icon as a refined tactile 3D product illustration. Use one large rounded sculptural object with a distinct silhouette that clearly represents the app, rendered in matte or satin ceramic and clay with subtle tactile grain and gently rounded edges. Choose a restrained palette of mist blue, blush, indigo, mint and cream, varying the subject color across the family. Fill the complete 1:1 square canvas edge to edge with a pale near-white lavender opaque background. Center the prominent subject with comfortable breathing room, soft upper-left studio lighting, ambient occlusion and grounded contact shadows. Keep perspective, scale, materials and lighting consistent across the family. Include no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; no transparent background, black/dark dock backdrop, baked-in rounded tile, border or visible frame; no sprite sheet or grid. The Matrix shell owns the final corner radius.
